mimo-v2.6-flash.description: Xiaomi MiMo's usage-priced mimo-v2.6-flash, the vendor's named replacement for the retiring mimo-v2.5. The vendor's OpenClaw and OpenCode integration guides bind the integers 1048576 (context) and 131072 (output) to this exact id, and its API reference gives [1, 131072] as the required range for max_completion_tokens (visible plus reasoning tokens). The model table shows only the rounded labels 1M and 128K, so nothing was expanded from it. This pilot declares text generate/stream; tools, vision, structured output and thinking controls await separate evidence. Account/model access is unverified.

instructions: 1. Sign in to the Xiaomi MiMo platform console with a Xiaomi account and create a pay-as-you-go API key at https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/#/console/api-keys.

2. mimo-v2.6-flash is usage-priced against your account balance. The vendor's promotions page describes bonus credit, from Refer & Earn or new-user registration, that offsets pay-as-you-go API usage and is currently valid for 40 days. Eligibility and amounts vary by campaign; your own entitlement and balance are unverified, and this is not a free tier.

3. Set {apiKeyEnvVar}. The vendor's own examples name the variable MIMO_API_KEY, which is read as a fallback. The key is sent as Authorization: Bearer to https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1/chat/completions (the vendor also accepts an api-key header, which this entry does not use).
4. Token Plan keys are a separate subscription product and are not covered by this entry. The declared scope is text generate and stream with mimo-v2.6-flash.
setup.description: Xiaomi MiMo text/stream pilot with a usage-priced mimo-v2.6-flash default. Bonus credit is a campaign-dependent promotion that offsets API usage; no account entitlement, roster, live inference or delivery is verified.
